newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent rises towards test of $20.00 on April.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent rises towards test of $20.00 on April.

text.p: Brent crude futures in Asia were firmer in late afternoon trading on Friday, extending London's overnight rally.
April on SIMEX was last traded at $19.90 per barrel, up 20 cents from London overnight. Volume was a modest 50 lots.
Brokers said sentiment had turned less bearish on Brent and players were looking to cover shorts, which they expected to lead to a test of a chart gap between $20.00 and $20.07 on the April contract.
But they said oil stock data from the International Eenergy Agency, which showed a surplus in January versus a year earlier for leading economies, might dampen the buying spirit seen in recent days.
One broker said $19.90 to $20.00 "looks crucial" to short term sentiment.
However, Brent had managed to shrug off news of higher OPEC and non-OPEC output in recent days, so it might just shrug off the IEA data, brokers said.
